headlines.title_en: Macro policies intensify for effectiveness, expand domestic demand, boost capital market resilience and confidence - latest Politburo meeting signals multiple messages
headlines.summary_en: Macro policy strengthens implementation, effectively expands domestic demand, boosts capital market resilience and confidence; latest Politburo meeting signals multiple messages. The Politburo met on July 30 to analyze the current economic situation and deploy H2 2024 work, focusing on property and stock markets, proposing to 'stabilize the property market' and 'enhance capital market resilience and confidence,' while emphasizing full use of existing policies and timely introduction of pragmatic incremental measures, alongside major deployments for expanding domestic demand and accelerating modern industrial system construction.

headlines.title: 乌克兰称收到欧盟34.7亿欧元国防援助贷款
headlines.summary: 乌克兰总理科列茨基30日在社交媒体发文称，乌克兰收到欧盟拨付的又一笔国防援助贷款，额度为34.7亿欧元。据乌财政部此前消息，欧盟将在今年年底前向乌克兰提供共计450亿欧元的贷款，其中283亿欧元将用于国防。科列茨基称，目前乌方已收到116亿欧元援助贷款，其中84亿欧元为国防援助贷款。欧盟于4月正式批准向乌克兰提供900亿欧元贷款，为乌提供2026年至2027年的财政与军事支持。（央视）

headlines.title_en: Ukraine says it received EU defense aid loan of 3.47 billion euros
headlines.summary_en: Ukrainian Prime Minister Shmyhal said on social media that Ukraine received another EU defense loan of 3.47 billion euros. The EU plans to provide Ukraine with a total of 45 billion euros in loans by end-2024, including 28.3 billion for defense. Shmyhal said Ukraine has received 11.6 billion euros so far, including 8.4 billion for defense. The EU approved a 90-billion-euro loan package in April to provide fiscal and military support for 2026-2027. (CCTV)

headlines.title: Price of parenting: the household maths giving China’s consumers pause
headlines.summary:
Qiu Huiying, a human resources manager in Guangdong, worries in numerical terms when she looks ahead to the next decade: a 20-year mortgage, a 10 per cent loss on her property and thousands of yuan in monthly childcare costs that are set to rise.
She bought a 624 sq ft flat last year, so her mother-in-law could move in and help care for her son. But the purchase now feels less prudent after prices in the 20-year-old complex have already fallen by about 10 per cent.

headlines.title: 库克称苹果Q2在中国大陆等新兴市场和部分发达市场打破纪录，公司股价盘后跌幅仍然扩大至5%
headlines.summary: 苹果公司CEO库克表示，尽管面临供应链限制和汇率逆风，苹果依然取得了响应的业绩。 尽管面临逆风，6月当季仍创下纪录。他正在大力推介公司的最新产品。他表示，苹果“全面”表现强劲，在印度、中国大陆、日本和东南亚均创下历史新高。同时，在部分发达市场和新兴市场也打破了纪录。 库克正在谈论Siri AI，表示开发者和公众测试版的反馈非常强烈。他表示收到的评价“极为出色”，这些成果“印证”了公司的AI战略。 库克引用IDC数据称，iPhone在当季市场份额有所提升。 苹果美股盘后跌幅扩大至5%。

headlines.title_en: Cook says Apple Q2 sets records in emerging markets like China and some developed markets, but shares still widen post-market drop to 5%
headlines.summary_en: Apple CEO Tim Cook said the company achieved solid results despite supply chain constraints and FX headwinds, setting a record for the June quarter. He is heavily promoting the latest products, noting strong performance across India, mainland China, Japan, and Southeast Asia, with records in both developed and emerging markets. Cook discussed Siri AI, saying feedback from developer and public betas is 'extremely strong' and validates the company's AI strategy. He cited IDC data showing iPhone market share increased in the quarter. Apple's after-hours stock fell 5%.

headlines.title: 日本媒体：日本实施汇市干预，美国亦进行了汇率询价
headlines.summary: 据日本经济新闻（Nikkei）援引市场参与者的消息报道，日本政府和日本央行于周四美国交易时段在外汇市场进行了干预，美国当局也同步进行了汇率询价（rate check）。 日本实施了大规模买入日元的干预操作。 纽约联邦储备银行在美国财政部的指示下，向多家银行询问了它们买卖货币的汇率。 美国财政部未回应日经新闻的问询。

headlines.title_en: Japanese media: Japan conducts FX intervention, US also makes exchange rate inquiry
headlines.summary_en: Japan's government and central bank intervened in the FX market during Thursday's US trading session, with US authorities also conducting rate checks, Nikkei reported citing market participants. Japan executed a large-scale yen-buying intervention. The New York Fed, under Treasury instructions, asked multiple banks about their FX rates. The US Treasury did not respond to Nikkei's inquiries.

headlines.title: 智利就Codelco引入私人资本释放复杂信号
headlines.summary: 随着智利财政部长Jorge Quiroz为私人资本的进入敞开大门，而智利国家铜业公司（Codelco）董事长Bernardo Fontaine却表示没有上市计划，智利官方就铜业巨头Codelco的未来释放了相互矛盾的信号。 尽管官员们在维持国家控制权方面立场一致，但财政部长Quiroz周三晚间表示，政府“在某个时候可能会引入私人资本”。然而，董事长Fontaine周四明确表示，Codelco并没有像其他一些国有公司那样，推进在股票市场出售股份的计划。

headlines.title_en: Chile sends mixed signals on bringing private capital into Codelco
headlines.summary_en: Chile sent mixed signals on the future of state copper giant Codelco, as Finance Minister Jorge Quiroz opened the door to private capital, while Chairman Bernardo Fontaine said there are no plans for an IPO. Although officials agree on maintaining state control, Quiroz said late Wednesday that the government 'could at some point bring in private capital.' However, Fontaine clarified Thursday that Codelco has no plans to sell shares on the stock market, unlike some other state-owned firms.
